sources.title: FSGS: Real-Time Few-shot View Synthesis using Gaussian Splatting
sources.snippet: To this end, we present FSGS, to model large-scale scenes from Sparse viewpoint inputs using 3D Gaussians as representation. To address the challenge of mitigating the gap in dense coverage from sparse input, the first challenge is how to move the locations of Gaussians effectively to cover and represent the 3D scene.
